data.content_ref: inline:The problem explicitly asks 'what exactly distinguishes an idempotent operation from a safe one' drawing on published definitions. SRC_001 never states the distinction. It merely labels it 'real but moot' and pivots entirely to the deduplication-key mechanism. Acknowledging a distinction exists without articulating its content is a direct failure to answer the first half of the problem as stated, regardless of whether the second half (which property the log requires) is answered well.
